calendar.empty_window: No events in the next {days} days.

weekly_briefing.description: Weekly overview: due dates, announcements, and recent grades
weekly_briefing.message: Using the available tools, give me a weekly briefing: tasks due in the next 7 days, recent announcements from the past 7 days, and grades published this week. Format: one section per course, ordered by urgency.

grade_audit.description: Grade audit: current standing and what is needed to pass
grade_audit.message_all: Analyse my grades across all courses. For each course: current percentage, projected grade, and what score I need on upcoming assignments to pass with a minimum passing grade. Use get_my_grades and get_assignments.
grade_audit.message_course: Analyse my grades in {courseName} (id={courseId}). Show: current percentage, projected grade, and what score I need on upcoming assignments to pass. Use get_my_grades and get_assignments.

study_planner.description: Study plan for the next {days} days based on due dates and calendar
study_planner.message: Build a study plan for the next {days} days based on my due dates and calendar events. Prioritise by deadline and assignment weight when available. Use get_upcoming_due_dates and get_calendar_events.

course_summary.description: Full summary of a specific course
course_summary.message: Give me a complete summary of {courseName} (id={courseId}): syllabus, content modules, pending assignments, and latest grades. Use get_syllabus, get_course_content, get_assignments, and get_my_grades.
